from collections import deque


def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out


def _elbow_orientation(cells):
    rs = [r for r,c in cells]; cs = [c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    s=set(cells)
    # An L has one bounding-box corner with neighbors along both axes.
    for r,c,dr,dc,tag in ((r0,c0,1,1,0),(r0,c1,1,-1,1),(r1,c0,-1,1,2),(r1,c1,-1,-1,3)):
        if (r,c) in s and (r+dr,c) in s and (r,c+dc) in s:
            # For a 3-cell L, this exactly identifies its elbow corner.
            return tag
    return None


def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    comps = _components(g)
    keys = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        on_v = min(rs)==0 or max(rs)==h-1
        on_h = min(cs)==0 or max(cs)==w-1
        if on_v and on_h:
            orient=_elbow_orientation(cells)
            if orient is not None:
                keys.append((color,cells,orient))
    if not keys:
        return g
    key_color,key_cells,orient=keys[0]
    rs=[r for r,c in key_cells]; cs=[c for r,c in key_cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    if orient==0: er,ec,dr,dc=r0,c0,1,1
    elif orient==1: er,ec,dr,dc=r0,c1,1,-1
    elif orient==2: er,ec,dr,dc=r1,c0,-1,1
    else: er,ec,dr,dc=r1,c1,-1,-1
    # The target lies in the quadrant opposite the open corner of the border L.
    from collections import Counter
    color_counts=Counter(color for color,cells in comps)
    cand=[]
    for color,cells in comps:
        if color==key_color or color_counts[color] < 2:
            continue
        cr=sum(r for r,c in cells)/len(cells); cc=sum(c for r,c in cells)/len(cells)
        if (cr-er)*dr <= 0 and (cc-ec)*dc <= 0:
            cand.append((abs(cr-er)+abs(cc-ec),cells,color))
    if cand:
        _,cells,color=min(cand,key=lambda x:x[0])
        for r,c in cells:
            g[r][c]=key_color
    return g
